newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ median house price flat again in June - REINZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ median house price flat again in June - REINZ.

text.p: New Zealand's national median house price was flat at NZ$162,000 in June, compared to NZ$162,500 in April and May, the Real Estate Institute (REINZ) said on Thursday.
The Auckland median price dropped by $3,000 to $232,000.
The REINZ said real estate agents reported 6,792 homes sold in June, down from 7,976 in May but up from 5,816 a year ago.
Sales in metropolitan Auckland totalled 2,178, down from 2,356 last month and up from 1,671 in June 1996.
REINZ president Colin Brown said the reduction in overall sales form the previous month was attributable to a short supply of listings.

"Traditionally listings at this time of the year are affected by the winter weather. The latest survey shows there is strong interest in property as revealed by the number of enquiries reported by real estate agents around the country. "This demand for propety is maintaining the steady prices recorded in the June figures," Brown said.
He said the latest levels of enquiry indicated provincial sales were back on stream after languishing for a long period.
Home sales in Wellington rose to 940 from 982 in May, while sales in the Canterbury/Westland region fell to 979 from 1,168 in May.
